Frequently asked questions

How do I delete my account and data?

In the app, go to Account → Delete Account and confirm. This deletes your account and all of your data. You can also email wenxin@attentionai.dev from the email associated with your account and ask us to delete it.

Deleting your account does not cancel an Attention Pro subscription billed by Apple — cancel it as described below.

How do I cancel Attention Pro?

Attention Pro is billed by Apple and renews monthly until you cancel. To cancel:

  1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
  2. Tap your name, then Subscriptions.
  3. Choose Attention and tap Cancel Subscription.

Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date to avoid being charged for the next month. You keep Pro until the end of the current period. For refunds, visit reportaproblem.apple.com.

How do I connect Gmail?

In the app, open Connections, choose Gmail, and tap Connect. Sign in with Google and review the permissions. Attention can then read your email and create drafts for you — it never sends anything without your explicit approval.

You can disconnect at any time in Connections, or revoke access at myaccount.google.com/permissions. Google Calendar, Google Drive, Calendly, and other connectors work the same way.

Do I need the Attention card?

No. The card is optional. The Attention app works on its own using your iPhone’s microphone; the card is a convenient way to capture conversations without taking out your phone.

What happens to other people’s voices in my recordings?

After transcription, Attention keeps only your own voice segments (for 60 days) and deletes the mixed recording, so other speakers’ audio isn’t retained. You’re responsible for following recording-consent laws where you are. See the Privacy Policy.

Why does Attention ask for Apple Health access?

It’s optional. If you allow it, Attention reads only your sleep analysis to time morning and evening check-ins. It never writes to Apple Health, and the data is never used for ads or shared. Turn it off in Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → Attention.

Can Attention buy or send things without asking me?

No. Whether it’s working through a connector or the cloud browser, Attention stops and asks for your approval before any submit, pay, or send action, and it never types your passwords.

How do I get a copy of my data?

Email wenxin@attentionai.dev to request access to or an export of your data.
